title: CLI: Implement C array format for TShark follow tap
description:
Implement the C array format for the TShark follow tap, as done for
Follow Stream in the GUI.

Also, add the index to the YAML format to match the GUI output for
that format.

Fix #14934

AI-Assisted: no

changes_data.diff:
@@ -1510,6 +1510,7 @@ in *TShark*, only in *Wireshark*.
 __mode__ specifies the output mode.  It can be one of:
 
   ascii  ASCII output with dots for non-printable characters
+  carray C arrays of chars
   ebcdic EBCDIC output with dots for non-printable characters
   hex    Hexadecimal and ASCII data with offsets
   raw    Hexadecimal data
